display_name: 源域相邻频谱比值的同记录匹配诊断
description: 比较正则化相邻频谱比值与归一化复数频谱，在固定源 IQ 配对上的同记录检索；不读取 TX、F、V 或目标。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU, one BLAS thread, nice 10; no GPU, no training

data.representation: Source received and clean IQ [2,256]; 672 distinct authorized L_s/U_s pilot IDs
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; no TX labels, not a held-out generalization test

permissions.claim_scope: Source same-record retrieval diagnostic only; source clean IQ supplies reference; not identity accuracy or target performance

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: source_inputs validates fixed source pilot metadata, L_s/U_s roles and RX/scene consistency
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No learned checkpoint, no F weights or outputs
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed comparison and regularization 0.01 before data access

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, one BLAS thread, nice 10; preserve other processes
execution.launch_command: nice -n 10 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u -m experiments.phase1_dura_orthogonal.spectral_quotient_probe --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261108-phase1-spectral-quotient-source-diagnostic-s2026092701-r01 --commit 7ed869a93a26e353a851a36e36f3e129cec4abbd
execution.stop_rule: Stop own process on source contract mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite data, output collision, or unauthorized data access; preserve artifacts.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source paired IQ only; no target truth

rows.method: Regularized adjacent complex FFT ratio versus complex FFT; unit L2 norm and phase-invariant cosine; regularization 0.01
rows.purpose: Source-only viability diagnostic, no target performance claim
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source pilot and existing source augmentation epoch19; no model training or randomness.
rows.budget_ref: 672 source IQ pairs, 48 per RX group and view; eight-record source smoke
rows.command: nice -n 10 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u -m experiments.phase1_dura_orthogonal.spectral_quotient_probe --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261108-phase1-spectral-quotient-source-diagnostic-s2026092701-r01 --commit 7ed869a93a26e353a851a36e36f3e129cec4abbd

notes: Source records are the unit of retrieval, not transmitter identities; source clean reference makes the diagnostic nondeployable.

Prerecorded research criterion: quotient top-1 exceeds spectrum by at least 5 percentage points in at least 8 of 12 damaged source groups to justify further source-only investigation; no target feedback or automatic deployment.
No learned checkpoint is consumed, so a real-checkpoint smoke is not applicable; eight real-source no-query samples run first.
Frequency-ratio motivation: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08402; this diagnostic does not assume repeated OFDM symbols, perform receiver calibration, or reproduce its classifier.
